title: Employer directory
subtitle: Check a company before you take the job
body: Every registered employer, with the pay-reliability score the contracts compute from their actual funding history. No wallet needed to read this page.
emptySearch: Nothing on this page matches. Try another page, or search the full address.

profile.notFound: That is not a valid wallet address.
profile.notRegistered: This address has not registered as an employer on IMGEUM.
profile.scoreBody: Computed on-chain from settled pay periods — on-time settlements raise it, arrears lower it, and a recent arrears event lowers it hardest.
profile.arrearsBody: Permanent, public evidence records filed against this employer. Anyone can open the underlying record and re-verify it against GIWA's own contracts.
profile.arrearsNone: No arrears have ever been recorded against this employer.

share.heading: Show this score in a job posting
share.body: An image that reads the score live from the contracts every time it loads. Paste it into a job posting, a careers page or a README — it always shows the current record, never a screenshot of a good day.
